title: Top 5 countries by revenue
question: Show the top 5 countries by total revenue from dbt_dev_gold.mart_rec_sales_gold_28f6ea4c. The Sales column is the revenue measure. Sum Sales by Country, order descending, limit 5. Use the governed warehouse analytics path.

stages.label: Format answer
stages.detail: Turning the bounded result into a concise answer.

result.generated_sql:
SELECT
  "Country",
  SUM("Sales") AS total_revenue
FROM dbt_dev_gold.mart_rec_sales_gold_28f6ea4c
GROUP BY "Country"
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
